## Empirical anchor

Arc 24 Phase 3 VERA p7 probe-spec defect: verbatim regex pattern finds 2 matches at MAJOR_PLINY.md lines 258+273 (one is in the python template body, one is in the example documentation); the anchored variant '^last=' returns 1 match as intended (the actual template start).

Surfaced 2026-05-13 by VERA in Arc 24 Phase 3 verdict. Non-blocking for Arc 24 ship — probe-spec imprecision, not a build defect.

## Substrate touch-point

substrate/CAPTAIN_VERA.md or a probe-authoring discipline note in operating-disciplines.md: when authoring probe-specs that match canonical templates in substrate prose, anchor the regex with '^' or use unique-substring delimiters. Multi-match probe specs return false-positives whenever the substrate prose itself documents the template (canonical template + example documentation = 2 hits, even when the prose intends 1).

## Gauntlet

ADA + CATO eyeball. Substrate doc-only edit; ~10-20 LOC of probe-discipline guidance. Low-priority hygiene.

## Sequencing

P3. Arc 25+ candidate. Not blocking anything.
title: Arc 24 follow-up — probe-spec ^last= anchor needed (verbatim regex finds 2, anchored variant returns 1 as intended)
